text:
Alice - Sales: Quick one — MediCorp asked for a compact evidence bundle for their legal + audit team. They specifically called out a minor network segmentation deviation from our SOC 2 docs and want: pen-test letter, iso artifacts excerpt, and a timeline for POC creds and evidence handoff. Can we assemble a short packet?
Raj - Security: I can pull the SOC 2 scope excerpt and the control mapping. The "deviation" sounds like their infra reviewer flagged cross-az management plane access. We have a standard statement we use for minor findings. I'll draft. :writing_hand:
Olga - Ops: For handoff, we usually provide a presigned S3 or SFTP depending on customer policy. MediCorp prefers SFTP. I'll prep a temp account and lock to their IPs.
Alice - Sales: Thanks — they also asked whether choosing Dedicated (single-tenant) vs Hosted changes the pen-test letter / evidence cadence and pricing. Need a short line for the commercial lead.
Tim - Legal: Pen-test letter: we can sign a customer-facing attestation referencing our latest external pentest date and scope, but for Dedicated deployments we include host-level isolation specifics. Lead time for signature is ~3 business days after security sign-off.
Sara - Eng: If they want config snippets for network segmentation or flow logs, I can pull the sample VPC peering and KMS key rotation doc. For Dedicated there are extra artifacts (node isolation diagram).
Raj - Security: Draft plan: 1) SOC 2 excerpt + control mapping (same day) 2) Pen-test attestation draft (1-2 business days) 3) Dedicated node/network diagram (if they opt Dedicated) (2-3 business days). Is that timeline ok?
Alice - Sales: That should work. Can we get a one-liner about pricing impact? Even a rough delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for POC? Customer wants to know if evidence requirements will push cost up.
Olga - Ops: Short answer: Dedicated typically has a setup/commit that increases monthly cost; evidence delivery itself doesn't change pricing, but Dedicated often requires longer onboarding and staging which we sometimes bill as a one-time setup. Suggest: "Dedicated = additional setup fee + higher committed monthly rate; evidence delivery included but staging support may be quoted separately."
Raj - Security: I'll attach a redacted pen-test summary and our standard attestation template. Note: we never share raw vuln scan output — only sanitized summaries and mitigation status.
Alice - Sales: Perfect. MediCorp also asked for instructions to upload their internal POC logs for us to ingest into the Sandbox during the POC. Can we provide a short command and retention note?
Olga - Ops: Provide SFTP creds + a one-time command. Example to give them: `sftp poc-upload@redwood-sftp.example.com` then `put /path/to/logs.tar.gz`. We'll expire creds after 7 days.
Sara - Eng: Also add this snippet for masking PII before upload: ```bash
# remove obvious email-like tokens
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' logs.txt > logs-sanitized.txt
```
Alice - Sales: Nice. Tim — any redlines on the attestation language we should flag to the customer ahead of time?
Tim - Legal: Two notes: (1) We can't assert individual CVE statuses — only confirm that an external pentest was completed and high-level severity counts. (2) For Dedicated, mention that some node-level telemetry may be omitted from hosted SLA language due to customer-managed network. I'll add both as brief bullets.
proofbot: evidence-upload-bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence-temp/medi-corp-1717774321 (auto-expire in 14 days)
Alice - Sales: Great — next steps: Raj to drop SOC 2 excerpt + attestation draft, Olga to send SFTP instructions and temp creds, Tim to add two legal bullets, Sara to include masking snippet and node diagram placeholder. I'll bundle and send to the customer today.
Raj - Security: On it. Will post draft in this thread when ready.
Olga - Ops: I'll DM Alice the initial creds and post a checklist once the bucket/sftp creds are live.
Tim - Legal: Will review attestation before sending.
Sara - Eng: I'll attach the node diagram (redacted) to the thread by EOD.
Alice - Sales: Thanks team :raised_hands: — I'll cc commercial with the rough Dedicated vs Hosted note so pricing can prep a quote.
